topics.t: Should Japan accept more workers from other countries?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 人口が減って、介護や農業で働く人が足りない
理由2: 多様な考えが新しいアイデアや経済の成長につながる
まとめ: 受け入れの準備(言語・生活の支援)も大切
qs: What kinds of support do foreign workers need when they come to Japan?
Do you think language barriers are a serious problem in the workplace?

topics.t: Is space exploration worth its cost?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 衛星の技術が天気予報や通信など生活を支えている
理由2: 新しい技術が医療や環境の分野にも使われる
まとめ: 国どうしの協力で費用を分け合える
qs: Should private companies play a bigger role in space exploration?
Some people say the money should be spent on problems on Earth. What do you think?

topics.t: Can technology solve the problem of climate change?
outline: 立場: 一部は解決できる
理由1: 再生可能エネルギーや電気自動車で排出を減らせる
理由2: しかし技術だけでは不十分で、生活の変化も必要
まとめ: 技術と個人・政府の行動の両方が必要
qs: What can individuals do to reduce their carbon footprint?
Should air travel be more expensive to protect the environment?

topics.t: Should cities limit the use of cars in their centers?
outline: 立場: Yes
理由1: 渋滞と大気汚染が減る
理由2: 歩きやすい街は店や観光にも良い
まとめ: 公共交通を便利にすることが条件
qs: How would limiting cars affect people who live in the suburbs?
Do you think public transportation in Japan is good enough?

topics.t: Are online friendships as meaningful as face-to-face ones?
outline: 立場: No(同じではない)
理由1: 表情や体験を共有することで信頼が深まる
理由2: ただしオンラインは遠くの人や同じ趣味の人とつながれる
まとめ: 両方の良さを組み合わせるのが大切
qs: Do social media sites make people feel lonely?
Should schools teach students how to use social media safely?
